LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL_REVIEW_READY_NOT_OWNER_APPROVED (five genuine admissible swaps): +Fierce Guardianship -Stubborn Denial; +Consign to Memory -Feed the Swarm; +Black Market Connections -Cover of Darkness; +Ornithopter of Paradise -Fellwar Stone; +Skullclamp -Sheoldred's Edict. Seeded goldfish (seed 29, 20000 games, on the play, paired common random numbers): P(Lord of Tresserhorn on the battlefield) turn 5 0.4783 -> 0.5290, turn 6 0.6121 -> 0.6613; P(Lord on the battlefield without paying its ETB) turn 6 0.2021 -> 0.2081; P(Lord attack-ready with a conversion card) turn 6 0.2352 -> 0.2683; P(Lord out with a free counter/protection in hand) turn 6 0.1208 -> 0.1969; mean cards seen by turn 6 12.000 -> 12.386. Disclosed losses: spot removal 5 -> 3 (Feed the Swarm and Sheoldred's Edict cut; Terminate, Deadly Rollick, Chaos Warp kept plus Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act, Goblin Bombardment, Otawara); enchantment removal 2 -> 1 hard answer (Chaos Warp) plus Otawara bounce; Stubborn Denial was an owner-cycle add (2026-10-14) and Fierce Guardianship was author-rejected in that closure but reopened by M6 Pass C Stage A. Spellbook 19 -> 19 included combos (no new, none lost); Game Changers 2 -> 3 (Fierce Guardianship); lands 35 -> 35; Bracket 4 unchanged.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged). Keeps Sheoldred's Edict, no Skullclamp. Goldfish turn 6: on battlefield 0.6563, conversion 0.2651, cards seen 12.120 (candidate 0.6613 / 0.2683 / 12.386). Grid B3: Edict alone among the kept spot removal answers a hexproof creature (2/14 cells; Toxic Deluge and Blasphemous Act still answer it). Owner choice if Edict's hexproof/planeswalker coverage is valued over the card engine.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (staged; closest competitor). Goldfish turn 6 0.6672 / 0.2691 / 12.382, within Monte Carlo noise of the candidate. Not preferred because the goldfish does not model tutoring: Muddle the Mixture transmutes for mana value 2 (Torpor Orb, Karn, Argent Defender, Demonic Tutor, Phyresis, Lightning Greaves), i.e. it finds the commander's ETB suppressors, and is also an instant/sorcery counter.
REJECT. Cutting Nightscape Familiar (one generic off Lord and other blue/red spells, regenerating Zombie fodder) costs deployment: turn 6 on battlefield 0.6438 versus candidate 0.6613.

REJECT (Pass C requested comparison; Soul's Fire in the Skullclamp slot). Grid B2: Soul's Fire kills in 216/972 cells versus Pain for All 108 (instant, can be cast in response to removal) and Temur Battle Rage 174; single-swap goldfish conversion turn 6 0.2631 versus baseline 0.2352. But grid B3: Sheoldred's Edict answers 10/14 interaction cells versus Soul's Fire 4 (7 Edict-only, 1 Soul's Fire-only); Soul's Fire is dead without Lord. Pain for All (owner-cycle add) already fills the instant conversion role, so the Soul's Fire add is not counted (no padding).

REJECT (Pass C requested cut). Single swap: turn 6 on battlefield 0.6121 -> 0.5856 (-2.65 points, outside noise) because Nightscape is a cost reducer and a sacrifice body. The candidate cuts Stubborn Denial instead (single swap 0.6094, within noise), and grid B4 shows Fierce Guardianship answers 17/40 cells versus Stubborn Denial 9 (8 FG-only, 0 Denial-only).

REJECT (Pass C requested comparison). Dropping to 34 lands costs deployment: turn 6 on battlefield 0.6613 -> 0.6490. Rogue's Passage is repeatable unblockability that survives Lord being recast; Distortion Strike is a one-shot sorcery (+1 power helps commander damage only with double strike).

REJECT (post-five challenge). Grid B1: with Shizo available, Aqueous Form connects in 15/24 evasion cells versus Cover of Darkness 12 and its aura falls off whenever Lord is exiled, bounced or recast. Goldfish turn 6 0.6637 (noise). Muddle the Mixture's transmute access to the suppressors outweighs a sixth evasion piece.

REJECT (inadmissible; my prior draft). Temur Battle Rage is an owner-cycle CUT in the 2026-10-14 Lord of Tresserhorn closure (owner reason: base Lord deals only 20 commander damage with double strike; Uncaged Fury makes him 11 power), and no M6 Pass C item reopened it, so it cannot be re-added. Measured for disclosure: turn 6 on battlefield 0.6538 and without paying the ETB 0.1923 versus the candidate 0.6613 / 0.2081. Pain for All (an owner-cycle add) is kept.

REJECT (my first five-swap plan, superseded by measurement): +Fierce Guardianship -Nightscape Familiar, +Skullclamp -Fellwar Stone, +Soul's Fire -Sheoldred's Edict, +Temur Battle Rage -Pain for All (owner-cut, inadmissible), +Aqueous Form -Cover of Darkness. Turn 6 on battlefield 0.5674 versus baseline 0.6121: cutting a rock and a cost reducer delays the commander.
